result:
I finished and confirmed the stopped run's T-DG5-BE-O work, and every acceptance check passed on the final tree. Integration needed two attempts because my tool stopped the first one at its time limit; nothing failed. This run changed no source or test files; it only completed the handback and added fresh logs. Run time was 03:12:59Z to 05:05:16Z, about 112 minutes, so a little past the 100-minute mark. Everything is left uncommitted on top of WIP `3e3dca9`.

**What I found:**
- Every file the drafted handback lists exists, contains what it says, and is complete.
- The handback had two placeholders: the end time and the whole checks section. Both are now filled from this run's own results.
- The stopped run's logs are not usable as evidence:
  - Its integration log was cut off mid-suite, with no summary and no exit line.
  - Both of its unit logs end in exit 1. The failures were a RAID web test and an architecture-test timeout, both outside my files and most likely caused by load from the other tasks running at the same time.

All my logs carry the `-B` suffix.

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| DG4 historical validator, at start and end | 0, 0 | `PASS gate DG4 (historical)` |
| `pnpm -r typecheck`, `pnpm -r build`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm openapi:lint` | 0 each | 846 operations |
| Repo-wide prettier check, run twice on the final tree | 0, 0 | all files formatted |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset | 0 | 2099 + 1429 + 259 passed, 2 skipped |
| `pnpm test`, `C.UTF-8` | 0 | same counts |
| Integration suite, one full run (ports 24920/24921-24949) | 0 | 260 files, 2493 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed |

**Disclosed in the handback:**
- **First integration attempt:** stopped by my tool's 30-minute background limit, not by a failure. Up to then 250 of 260 files had passed (2469 tests passed, 1 skipped). The 10 files left passed in a second invocation (24 tests, exit 0). The full single run in the table came after both.
- **First C.UTF-8 unit start:** killed along with its shell before any test ran; the full re-run is the one in the table.
- **Skips:** the 1 integration skip is the planned pending REQ-S10-013 live-presentation test, which waits for KBE-D2's meeting-pack assembler. The 2 unit skips are in the formula fuzz suite, which isn't my code; the stopped run's logs show the same skips.

**Summary of the delivered work:**
- **Migrations:** none.
- **Endpoints routed:**
  - `GET /api/v1/transformations/{transformationId}/meetings/{meetingId}/presentation[?snapshotId=]`
  - `GET /api/v1/transformations/{transformationId}/evidence-register`
  - `GET /api/v1/transformations/{transformationId}/evidence/{evidenceId}/versions`
- **Pending list:** `p5-pending-be-o.ts` is now empty; the three operations are exercised in the contract test.
- **Pinned counts:** unchanged.

**Still open, needs you:**
- **Wiring line:** the live presentation needs one line added to `apps/api/src/server.ts`. That file is outside my scope; the proposed code is in §5.1 of the handback. Apply it in the same merge as KBE-D2, or the pending test will fail as soon as it activates.
- **Shared zod schemas:** none exist for the three response types. I wrote strict versions in the test file and propose moving them into `packages/shared`.
- **Untracked files not to integrate:** the worktree root has empty, read-only files (`.bashrc`, `.gitmodules`, `CLAUDE.local.md` and others) created by the sandbox, not by me.

Files are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/`:
- T-DG5-BE-O-backend-workflow-engineer.md
- T-DG5-BE-O-evidence/
